objects_encounters_85.col_3: Deployable, Gadget, Breakable(3-hit), hitsToDestroy=3, Fixed-Hits-Durability, Repairable
objects_encounters_85.col_4: No (occupies its tile; per-item pattern/placement rules apply)
objects_encounters_85.col_5: Passive (created by using a Deployable-category Consumable Item)
objects_encounters_85.col_6: Destroyed when it takes 3 hits (any source)
objects_encounters_85.col_7: DURABILITY RULE (USER RULING 2026-10-20): Objects/deployables/gadgets created by Deployable-category Consumable Items use the SAME fixed-hits-to-destroy durability model as existing breakable blocker-prop objects - hitsToDestroy = 3: it takes 3 hits from any source to destroy, NOT a damage-based HP pool. This is the Breakable(3-hit) convention already used by Ice Spike and Blocker-Prop Cluster. Repair (SKL-REPAIR) fully resets a deployed gadget's remaining hits back to its maximum (3), i.e. a 3-hit gadget returns to full 3 hits.
objects_encounters_85.col_8: Until destroyed (3 hits) or its item-defined duration expires
objects_encounters_85.col_9: AUTHORED 2026-10-20 (consumable-slot-unlock / deployable-support system). Cross-reference: objects_encounters Ice Spike (Breakable(3-hit)) and Blocker-Prop Cluster (Breakable(3-hit)) - "3 hits from any source to destroy". NOTE / DEV FLAG: existing Deployable consumable_items currently express durability as damage-based HP pool formulas (e.g. Sentry Turret "HP = 22 + 0.65xIL + 0.40xVIT", Barrier Pylon "Barrier HP = 25 + 0.75xIL + ...", Hardlight Wall segments). This ruling establishes the fixed 3-hits-to-destroy model as the canonical deployable-object durability; reconciling those per-item HP formulas to the 3-hit model (or flagging intended exceptions) is a Dev/Designer follow-up. Repair (SKL-REPAIR) resets remaining hits to max. Design/DB ruling only; engine wired separately by Dev.

consumable_framework_39.rule: Objects/deployables/gadgets created by Deployable-category Items have 3 HP and require 3 hits to destroy, using the fixed hitsToDestroy=3 model (Breakable(3-hit) convention; same as Ice Spike and Blocker-Prop Cluster in objects_encounters), NOT a damage-based HP pool. Repair (SKL-REPAIR) fully resets a deployed gadget's remaining hits to max (a 3-HP gadget returns to full 3 hits). Full spec: objects_encounters "Deployed Gadget / Object (Deployable-category consumable)".
consumable_framework_39.notes: USER RULING 2026-10-20. Design/DB ruling only; engine wired separately by Dev.
